Alex K: Quick sync — we're doing a staggered shim surge for client adapters tonight 23:00 UTC. Owners: @MayaS and @SashaR. Can people confirm smoke + rollback readiness? :eyes:
Maya S: I’ll own smoke for JS + Python SDKs. Running telemetry + basic request/response sanity. ETA preflight 22:15 UTC.
Sasha R: I can do canary buckets (10% -> 25% -> 50%). Need infra to apply routing change; I pinged them in #eng-infra.
Jordan P: Heads up — one tiny test fix left in PR, everything else green. @Alex K can you approve when you have a sec? https://github.com/redwood/clients/pull/987
Phil G: Compatibility note: older clients should receive a clear 400 with upgrade guidance if shim not present. If we can’t do graceful fallback, we should auto-proxy for one release.
Alex K: Plan: canaries at 23:00 / 23:30 / 00:00 UTC. If smoke shows >10% error rate for any canary, immediate rollback to previous shim image. Rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/adapter --to-revision=stable`
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy at 23:00 UTC (canary config: 10%).
Maya S: Smoke script I'll run (local): ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"smoke test"}'
``` also will run a concurrency burst: `for i in {1..50}; do curl ... & done`
Sasha R: infra replied — routing change ready at 22:45. I’ll tag canary buckets in OpsDash and watch request distribution.
Jordan P: PR merged after Alex's approval, tagged `v25.1-shim`.
Alex K: Nice. Final checklist: owners assigned (Maya/Sasha), smoke commands posted, rollback command posted, and client comms draft. @Phil G can you post a short partner note after canary-2 saying what changed + any action items?
Phil G: Yup — drafting message now, will drop in #partners in ~10m.
Maya S: Running preflight smoke at 22:50 and will paste summarized results here (latency, error %, sample outputs).
Sasha R: Adding a lightweight health probe to shim: `/health?probe=canary` — will use for alerting.
Alex K: I’ll stay on watch for the first hour. If anything weird, escalate to oncall (SRE). :thumbsup:
